options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: grp_desc
options.description: The description of the device group.

options.name: grp_members
options.description: A comma separated list of device names or device groups to be added as members to the device group. If Group Members are defined, and mode="delete", only group members will be removed. If you want to delete a group itself, you must omit this parameter from the task in playbook.

options.name: grp_name
options.description: The name of the device group.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values

options.name: vdom
options.description: The VDOM of the Fortigate you want to add, must match the device in FMGR. Usually root.
